1.0.0: First stable release: manage garments, tag photos with AI, search and find duplicates, generate three try-on views, and sync across devices.
1.0.1: The AI-generated badge is now a glass capsule in the bottom right of the image, visible against any background.
1.0.2: Generated models and try-on images now use soft, even lighting for more natural faces.
1.0.3: Fixed diagonal grid shadows on faces in AI-generated model and try-on images.
1.0.4: Cleaned up grid patterns and grain before reusing AI images as references, reducing artifacts from repeated edits.
1.0.5: Added face refinement and shortened the reference pipeline. Connection errors are now reported as such.
1.0.6: Evened out skin tones and removed yellow-gray patches and dark areas around the chin.
1.0.7: Restored wardrobe and recent-item photos after backup import, with missing thumbnails regenerated automatically.
1.0.8: Try-on results retain the model’s facial identity across outfit changes, with fewer patches, shadows, and distortions.
1.0.9: Restored pose creation from photos and face processing. Image generation now continues in the background.
1.0.10: Fixed APK installation on OPPO, realme, and OnePlus phones that require a legacy signature.
1.0.11: Fixed face and neck seams in side-view try-ons with poses and made opening try-on history from Profile more reliable.
1.0.12: Generate four views of a model together. Added makeup, retouching, and expression options with a soft portrait style by default.
1.0.13: Photo poses retain the original bent knees, gestures, and perspective across all three try-on views.
1.0.14: Choose a built-in studio or extract a background from a photo. Generate outfit, pose, and background together across three views.
1.0.15: Identify layered garments individually, review their crops and order, and preserve left/right placement and garment construction in back views.
1.0.15-r1: Unified item categories and search, show each selected garment in try-on history, and improved headband search and accessory consistency across views.
1.0.16: Wardrobe now follows your phone’s language and supports eight languages. The website adds regional language selection and updated screenshots.
1.0.16-r1: Choose the app language in Profile. Every website screenshot now matches the page language.
